subject.title: feat: catch storefront up to unmanaged product sellability

question: Should the generic store starter adopt Commerce's unmanaged manual-availability journey and advance to Commerce commit 8ca3e5d as part of its default dogfood surface?
rationale: The implementation is bounded and proof-backed, but it adds a new user-facing starter capability and changes the pinned pre-release dependency baseline.

options.title: Adopt the verified journey
options.body: Accept the Commerce pin and merge the bounded unmanaged-sellability proof surface as part of the starter baseline.

options.title: Keep the managed-only baseline
options.body: Decline the additional starter surface and retain the existing managed Inventory proof until product scope is confirmed.

recommendation.title: Adopt the verified journey
recommendation.body: Accept the Commerce pin and merge the bounded unmanaged-sellability proof surface as part of the starter baseline.
